description: The offshore GeoIndex shows the range of marine geoscience data we hold within the National Geoscience Data Centre (NGDC). This is primarily shallow geology and geophysics data collected as either part of regional or local mapping work, or provided to us by third parties. The BGS is the Marine Environment Data and Information Network (MEDIN) data archive centre (DAC) for geology, geophysics and backscatter.
